name: – Nils Ušakovs – After § 57 – Am 34
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 57a. Stresses the need for a structural and objective reassessment of the EU’s decentralised agencies, noting that their proliferation has led to administrative fragmentation, overlapping competences and disproportionate operating costs; calls for timely, independent and legally required evaluations of EU agencies and bodies to assess whether they still operate in line with their mandates and with the principles of sound financial management, and advocates for the dissolution of agencies whose operational and budgetary relevance is insufficient, with a view to reallocating the corresponding resources so that they can be used more efficiently;
